title: "Imagine? Where do you think you are right now": a three-post exchange about scrolling through software
summary: On Tue 17 Nov 23:29Z @harsimony.bsky.social (1,952 followers) posted: "With stuff like the Chimera voice, the fruit fly connectome, and people posting minigames, its clear that software objects are becoming memes too." and "Interesting to imagine a social media site where you can scroll through different software." (41 likes). At 01:15Z @handackett.bsky.social (Dan, 461 followers) replied: "Imagine? Where do you think you are right now" (8 likes). Thirteen hours later the first account answered with a question: "Oh, what bluesky feed allows you to frictionlessly scroll through software objects that publicly record how users interact with them?" The digest holds no further reply.
